chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about greeting one who is praying, so he said:
"If a man from the Muslims greets you while you are in salat (prayer), then reply to him within yourself and do not raise your voice."

key_terms.التَّسْلِيمِ: the act of offering greeting or salām

ai.seo_question: How should a person respond to a Muslim's greeting while in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about returning a greeting while one is in salat (prayer). It indicates that if a Muslim greets the worshipper, he should respond inwardly and not raise his voice, preserving the composure of the prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1064 - Ammar al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about greeting someone while in prayer.
Imam (as) said: "If a man from the Muslims greets you while you are in prayer, respond to him within yourself and do not raise your voice”.
